title: Unscripted: Which part of this moment will look obvious in twenty years and which will look absurd?
abstract:
Evan Ratliff spent a year running a company staffed almost entirely by AI agents. Tim Berglund has spent his career explaining new technology to developers, long enough to have watched a few waves come and go.

Two people with a lot of recent evidence, trying to sort the durable from the ridiculous. No predictions promised.

This is our unscripted stage. No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.
